function render(){const q=$('search').value.trim().toLowerCase();const shown=products.filter(p=>(activeCategory==='Все'||p.cat===activeCategory)&&(!q||(p.name+' '+p.cat+' '+p.desc).toLowerCase().includes(q)));$('productCount').textContent=shown.length;$('productGrid').innerHTML=shown.map(p=>`<article class="product"><div class="photo"><img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.name}"><span class="tag">${p.tag}</span><button class="zoom" data-open="${p.id}" aria-label="Увеличить фото">↗</button></div><div class="product-info"><div class="product-title">${p.name}</div><div class="product-sub">${p.cat.toUpperCase()} · ${p.colors.join(' / ')}</div><div class="product-bottom"><span class="price">${rub(p.price)}</span><button class="smallbtn" data-open="${p.id}">Подробнее</button></div></div></article>`).join('');document.querySelectorAll('[data-open]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openProduct(b.dataset.open));document.querySelectorAll('.photo img').forEach(img=>img.onclick=()=>openProduct(img.closest('.product').querySelector('[data-open]').dataset.open));}
function openProduct(id){activeProduct=products.find(p=>p.id===id);selectedColor=activeProduct.colors[0];selectedSize=(activeProduct.sizes||[])[0]||'';$('modalImage').src=activeProduct.image;$('modalTitle').textContent=activeProduct.name;$('modalTag').textContent='VESTRA / '+activeProduct.tag;$('modalDesc').textContent=activeProduct.desc;$('modalFeatures').innerHTML=activeProduct.features.map(x=>'• '+x).join('<br>');$('modalPrice').textContent=rub(activeProduct.price);$('sizeLabel').style.display=activeProduct.sizes?'block':'none';$('sizeOptions').style.display=activeProduct.sizes?'flex':'none';drawChoices();$('productOverlay').classList.add('open')}
function drawChoices(){$('colorOptions').innerHTML=activeProduct.colors.map(c=>`<button class="chip ${c===selectedColor?'selected':''}" data-color="${c}">${c}</button>`).join('');$('colorOptions').querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{selectedColor=b.dataset.color;drawChoices()});$('sizeOptions').innerHTML=(activeProduct.sizes||[]).map(s=>`<button class="chip ${s===selectedSize?'selected':''}" data-size="${s}">${s}</button>`).join('');$('sizeOptions').querySelectorAll('[data-size]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{selectedSize=b.dataset.size;drawChoices()})}
function toast(t){$('toast').textContent=t;$('toast').classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>$('toast').classList.remove('show'),1900)}
function add(){cart.push({id:activeProduct.id,color:selectedColor,size:selectedSize});updateCart();$('productOverlay').classList.remove('open');toast('Добавлено в корзину')}
function updateCart(){$('cartCount').textContent=cart.length;if(!cart.length){$('cartItems').innerHTML='<div class="cartempty">Корзина пока пуста</div>';$('cartTotal').textContent='0 ₽';return}let total=0;$('cartItems').innerHTML=cart.map((x,i)=>{let p=products.find(p=>p.id===x.id);total+=p.price;return `<div class="cartline"><img src="${p.image}" alt=""><div style="flex:1"><strong>${p.name}</strong><small>${x.color}${x.size?' · размер '+x.size:''}</small><strong>${rub(p.price)}</strong><div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="remove" data-remove="${i}">Убрать</button></div></div></div>`}).join('');$('cartTotal').textContent=rub(total);document.querySelectorAll('[data-remove]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{cart.splice(+b.dataset.remove,1);updateCart()})}
$('filters').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{activeCategory=b.dataset.cat;$('filters').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));render()});$('search').addEventListener('input',render);$('closeModal').onclick=()=>$('productOverlay').classList.remove('open');$('productOverlay').onclick=e=>{if(e.target===$('productOverlay'))$('productOverlay').classList.remove('open')};$('addToCart').onclick=add;$('openCart').onclick=()=>$('cartPanel').classList.add('open');$('closeCart').onclick=()=>$('cartPanel').classList.remove('open');$('checkout').onclick=()=>{if(!cart.length){toast('Сначала добавьте товар в корзину');return}const lines=cart.map((x,i)=>{let p=products.find(p=>p.id===x.id);return `${i+1}. ${p.name} — ${x.color}${x.size?' / '+x.size:''} — ${rub(p.price)}`});const msg='Здравствуйте! Хочу оформить заказ VESTRA:\n'+lines.join('\n')+'\nИтого: '+rub(cart.reduce((s,x)=>s+products.find(p=>p.id===x.id).price,0))+'\nПодскажите, пожалуйста, наличие и условия доставки.';window.open('https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A%2F%2Ft.me%2Fvestra_shop0102&text='+encodeURIComponent(msg),'_blank')};render();updateCart();
</script></body></html>
